- go.Handle mapping and thread-safety

- How to avoid GC stalls due to large frame copies?

// binding.go

import "C"
import "unsafe"

func ReverseGo(s string) string {
    c := C.CString(s)
    defer C.free(unsafe.Pointer(c))
    C.reverse_inplace(c)
    return C.GoString(c)
}
